title: Eight Sleep staggered pair
description: A light-grey band with a centered heading, a sub-line and a black button, then two tall rounded photo cards side by side with large white captions at the bottom-left. While you scroll (desktop), the left card slides from 209px below the right one to 209px above it, so the pair shears past each other. On phones the cards stack.
notes: two media slots, 652×837 on desktop and 350×450 on phones, radius 20px
the left card overhangs the next section by up to 209px while it drifts; leave the next section unclipped at the top
